occurrence: A pedestrian starts crossing ahead of the car
carla_effect: Spawn a walker ahead_dist_m ahead at the roadside and walk it across (jaywalker demo)

occurrence: A cyclist crosses or pulls into the lane ahead
carla_effect: Spawn a bicycle blueprint (e.g. vehicle.diamondback.century) on a path across the lane

occurrence: A skid spell: something ahead forces a hard stop on a wet road
carla_effect: Lower tire_friction via apply_physics_control on the segment, spawn a sudden stopped obstacle ahead, set rain and wetness for visuals

occurrence: An obstacle appears just inside the fog-reduced detection range
carla_effect: Set fog_density; Scenario API sets detection_range_m; spawn the obstacle at about 0.8 x that range

occurrence: A skid spell on a low-traction winter road
carla_effect: CARLA has no snow: emulate with very low tire_friction and a short detection range, and call it low traction in the report

occurrence: A gust pushes the car sideways
carla_effect: CARLA wind_intensity is visual only: apply a short lateral force or impulse to the ego car

occurrence: An engine overheat cuts available power
carla_effect: CARLA has no thermal model: emulate by capping throttle. Affects travel time more than safety

occurrence: The vehicle ahead brakes hard or a car cuts in
carla_effect: Traffic Manager vehicles ahead; force a hard brake or lane change. Density comes from the scenario traffic count

occurrence: A vehicle encroaches into the lane and leaves little room
carla_effect: Spawn a parked or oncoming car partly in the lane; odds scale with 1/lane_width (waypoint.lane_width)

occurrence: An unlit hazard appears inside the night-reduced detection range
carla_effect: Set sun_altitude_angle below the horizon; Scenario API sets detection range; spawn a dark-clothed walker or obstacle

occurrence: A hazard is hidden by glare while driving toward a low sun
carla_effect: Nonzero only where segment heading is within M degrees of sun azimuth and the sun is low; filter shortens range; spawn a hidden hazard

occurrence: A stopped or double-parked vehicle blocks the lane
carla_effect: Spawn a static vehicle in the lane

occurrence: Cross traffic runs a light or turns across the car's path
carla_effect: Cross-traffic vehicle with Traffic Manager ignore_lights_percentage, or an oncoming left turn

occurrence: Cones or barriers close part of the lane
A nearby car tailgates or speeds past
carla_effect: Traffic Manager vehicle_percentage_speed_difference and distance_to_leading_vehicle on a nearby car

occurrence: A hazard emerges from around a corner or parked cars at short range
carla_effect: Spawn an actor at short distance around the corner
